title: 第十章  我可以睡外面
content_zh:
“王少，是你自己摔倒的。”贾小亮小心的说道，虽然他也有点不相信一个人站的好好的能够没有预兆的摔倒，但事实摆在眼前，由不得他不相信

    “怎么可能！刚刚我明明感觉有人绊了我一脚！”王艺怒火攻心之下，脸上的狗屎竟然有部分掉进了他的嘴里，贾小亮在旁边看的一阵恶心，但又不敢说出口。

    还在车里坐着的苏林依跟孙依诗，瞪大了眼睛，她们知道肯定是陈木做了什么，不然一个人怎么可能无缘无故摔倒，摔倒也就算，王艺直接被摔的一脸狗屎。

    孙依诗顿时双眼露出小星星，兴奋道：“依依姐，你看王艺那个蠢货，竟然在吃屎！”说着还想拿出手机将王艺现在的样子拍下来。

    苏林依皱了皱眉，心里有些恶心，对王艺的印象更是跌倒谷底，将孙依诗的手机抢了过来，斥道：“小诗，不要捣乱！”

    孙依诗悻悻的摆了摆手，不过转眼又兴奋了起来，跟苏林依道：“依依姐，那个陈木好像挺厉害的样子，我刚刚都没看到他是怎么绊倒王艺的。”

    苏林依没有说话，眼中闪出一丝疑惑，刚刚他也没发现陈木是怎么做到的，好像就用身子撞了他一下，王艺就摔倒了。

    “王少，我知道是谁了，就是那家伙刚刚撞了你一下！”贾小亮脑中一亮，突然想到了刚刚好像一个穿的很土的家伙撞了王艺一下，便指着还没走太远的陈木说道。

    “给老子将他抓过来，老子要让他尝尝屎的味道！”王艺这时候也看到了陈木，感觉有些眼熟，不过却想不起来在哪见过，不过他王艺见的人多了，眼熟也正常，王艺没有多想，见到陈木穿着很普通，立即对贾小亮下令道

    “王少，这家伙应该是宁华大学的学生，我已经记住他长什么样子了，教训他时间有的是，我们还是先清理一下身上的那个狗。。。屎吧。”贾小亮有些小心的说道

    王艺皱了皱眉，刚刚情急之下，还没闻到自己脸上的臭味，现在一闻差点晕了过去，看着旁边围过来的学生越来越多，感觉跟贾小亮飞速离开了这里。不过王艺却要彻底将那人给查出来，然后让他好好吃一顿狗屎！
content_en:
"Young Master Wang, you fell down on your own." Jia Xiaoliang said carefully. Although he didn't believe that a person who was standing well could fall without warning, the facts were in front of him and he couldn't help but not believe it.

"How is that possible! Just now I clearly felt someone tripped me!" Wang Yi was so angry that some of the shit on his face actually fell into his mouth. Jia Xiaoliang looked disgusted but did not dare to say anything.

Su Linyi and Sun Yishi, who were still sitting in the car, opened their eyes wide. They knew that Chen Mu must have done something, otherwise how could a person fall down for no reason? Even if he fell, Wang Yi was thrown like shit.

Sun Yishi's eyes suddenly showed little stars, and she said excitedly: "Sister Yiyi, look at that idiot Wang Yi, he is actually eating shit!" As she said this, she wanted to take out her mobile phone to take a picture of Wang Yi's current appearance.

Su Linyi frowned, feeling a little sick, and her impression of Wang Yi fell to the bottom. She snatched Sun Yishi's cell phone and scolded: "Xiao Shi, don't make trouble!"

Sun Yishi waved her hands angrily, but then she became excited again and said to Su Linyi: "Sister Yiyi, that Chen Mu seems to be quite powerful. I didn't even see how he tripped Wang Yi just now."

Su Linyi said nothing, with a trace of doubt in his eyes. He didn't realize how Chen Mu did it just now. It seemed that he just hit him with his body, and Wang Yi fell down.

"Young Master Wang, I know who it is, that guy just bumped into you!" Jia Xiaoliang's mind suddenly flashed, and he suddenly thought that a guy in tacky clothes just bumped into Wang Yi, and pointed at Chen Mu who hadn't gone too far.

"Catch him here, I want him to taste shit!" Wang Yi also saw Chen Mu at this time. He felt a little familiar, but he couldn't remember where he had seen it before. However, Wang Yi had seen many people, so it was normal for him to look familiar. Wang Yi didn't think much about it. When he saw Chen Mu was wearing ordinary clothes, he immediately ordered Jia Xiaoliang.

"Master Wang, this guy should be a student of Ninghua University. I already remember what he looks like. I have plenty of time to teach him a lesson. Let's clean up the dog... shit on him first." Jia Xiaoliang said with some caution.

Wang Yi frowned. In his desperation just now, he hadn't smelled the stench on his face, but now he almost fainted when he smelled it. Seeing more and more students surrounding him, he felt that he and Jia Xiaoliang were leaving here very quickly.However, Wang Yi wanted to find out that person thoroughly, and then let him have a good meal of shit!
